title.narrative: Establishment of the Libyan National Seismological Network (LNSN)

description.narrative: The project consists of carrying out mutually agreed activities between the Libyan Centre for Remote Sensing and Space Sciences (LCRSSS) and UNESCO related to the “Upgrading of the Libyan National Seismological Network” (LNSN). The LNSN network was designed to monitor local, regional and teleseismic activities, as well as to provide high quality data for research projects both locally and on the regional and global scale. The LNSN consists of 15 stations (3 very broadband and 12 broadband), and a Central Processing Center, located in the City of Tripoli. Building the scientific capacities of Libyan specialists is a major component of the project.
